name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-effective-access-audit
title: Effective Access Audit
shortDescription: A read-only React web part that displays direct SharePoint role assignments.
longDescription: This SharePoint Framework sample uses PnPjs and Fluent UI 9 to show direct role assignments for the current web and an optional list. It validates site-relative paths, stays read-only, bounds results, and explains that nested groups and complete effective user access are not resolved.

references.name: PnPjs
